customManagers.description: Tool versions pinned as `ENV <NAME>_VERSION=` in a Dockerfile, opted in with a `# renovate: datasource=<datasource> depName=<depName>` comment on the line above.

packageRules.description: kubectl is only supported within one minor of the API server. The whole fleet runs 1.35 (2026-10), and 1.35.x covers 1.34-1.36. Raise this bound together with the cluster upgrades.
clusterctl must match the Cluster API core provider deployed on capi-mgt / capi-stg-mgt (v1.12.x). Raise this bound together with the capi-providers upgrade.
